Package cr.ac.una.parking.coto.model

Class ParkingSpace

java.lang.Object
cr.ac.una.parking.coto.model.ParkingSpace
public class ParkingSpace extends Object
Represents a physical parking slot and its current state.

Each space is identified by a numeric code and a SpaceType. The state can be available, occupied, or out of service. The class validates the compatibility between the space and the vehicle using the vehicle type information exposed by the abstraction.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Carolain Quesada and Ashly Delgado
